environment.runner: Docker Compose on a shared machine; Chromium in a separate container

method.cache: Fresh browser context per repetition; normal in-session browser caching; shared server cache; no page cache; first fixed run starts with empty delivery transient; subsequent runs use its five-minute lifetime
method.cart: Monotonic browser-driver wall time: click Update cart through updated GBP 52.50 total and unblocked UI
method.checkout: Click Place order through complete WooCommerce checkout AJAX JSON response; read-only XMLHttpRequest observer retains the native browser response before redirect; receipt and persisted order checked separately
method.network: Local Docker network, no throttling; delivery fixture responds after 900 ms in both states
method.order: Breakfast cup, quantity 2; GBP 48.00 + GBP 4.50 UK delivery; GBP 52.50; local cheque method

observed.invalid: Invalid email and postcode rejected; order count unchanged
